rv.q: While Shit. Meet. Fan. isn’t all that persuasive, it delivers jolts of spiky humor and a cast of hardworking household names.
O'Hara has started by taking the premise of the 2016. Italian film Perfect Strangers and transposed it to a uniquely American milieu.

cn.t: Star-studded adaptation of "Perfect Strangers" delivers scathing comedy about toxic masculinity and privilege, but critics find it stranded between sharp satire and heavy-handed drama, with contrived plotting undermining its button-pushing ambitions.
